title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
abstract: arXiv:2611.07854v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive approaches with large language models, such as long chain-of-thought reasoning, have become the default for new AI applications because they reach higher accuracy on a wide range of tasks. In production, however, they give inconsistent answers, require parsing of outputs, and add cost and latency. Decision models address this: given a question and a set of options supplied by the user, they return a probability distribution over the options without autoregressive decoding. We present Drex, a family of four open decision models with 8B (DLM), 9B (v1.5), 35B with 3B active (v2.0), and 27B (Max) parameters. Each request consists of a state (a document, record, or agent context, optionally with images) and questions about it, each asking for a choice among options, a yes/no judgment, or a score on an ordered scale. translated_abstract: 使用大型语言模型的自回归方法（如长链式思维推理）已成为新AI应用的默认方案，因为它们能在广泛任务上取得更高的准确率。然而在生产环境中，它们会给出不一致的答案、需要解析输出，并增加成本和延迟。决策模型解决了这一问题：给定一个问题和用户提供的选项集合，它们无需自回归解码即可返回各选项的概率分布。我们提出Drex，一个由四个开源决策模型组成的系列，参数量分别为8B（DLM）、9B（v1.5）、35B总参数/3B激活参数（v2.0）以及27B（Max）。每个请求由一个状态（文档、记录或智能体上下文，可选包含图像）以及关于该状态的问题组成，每个问题要求在选项中做出选择、进行是/否判断，或在有序量表上进行评分。训练结合了监督微调与来自调整反馈的强化学习（RLAF），并加入了视觉训练……
tldr: 提出Drex系列开源决策模型（8B至35B参数），通过监督微调与调整反馈强化学习（RLAF）训练，无需自回归解码即可对用户提供的选项直接输出概率分布，从而降低生产环境中的成本、延迟与答案不一致性。
en_tdlr: Drex is a family of open decision models (8B to 35B parameters) trained with supervised fine-tuning and Reinforcement Learning from Adjusted Feedback (RLAF), which return probability distributions over user-supplied options without autoregressive decoding, reducing cost, latency, and inconsistency in production AI applications.
